body.title: Groundwater level anomaly
body.note: Depth to water from NGA telemetry (10_1), one record per district; a month's value is the mean of its samples (about one every seven weeks), unsampled months are gaps. Anomaly vs the 2000–2025 same-month mean; + = water table higher.
